content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a question regarding a [product_name] operator device. Type: [article_no]. Is there a way to deactivate the IP configuration menu? I want to prevent operators from altering the IP address in the device menu. Additionally, is it possible to disable the menu displaying inputs, outputs, and flags? Thank you for your input.
Which IP menu are you aiming to disable? Is it the one where the IP address of the base module can be modified, or the one for the operator device?

Hello, thank you for responding. I specifically want to block access to the menu where the IP address of the operator device is shown. Based on what I've found, it seems to be part of the system and cannot be deactivated—there is no documentation detailing this option. You can secure the base module menu with a password via the configuration software, which works as needed.
If you switch the device settings to operator mode, it prevents changes to the operator device's IP address. However, users can still select among several pre-existing IP addresses.

Hi, if you use the latest version of the base module with the operator device, switching to operator mode (password-protected; changing back to admin mode also requires a password), will block IP changes and other functions such as RUN/STOP. To access this menu on the operator device: Press the down cursor, then Time & Date appears on the screen, press escape, go to Settings, Setup, and switch to operator mode. Remember the password—the default is set to [product_name]. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to limit changes to network and system settings via the operator device's menus. There is concern about operators accessing sensitive configurations such as IP addresses and system status. Current solutions may not provide fine-grained control, and information in official resources appears inadequate or unclear to users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want to completely restrict or password-protect access to IP configuration and status menus on the operator device, to secure against unauthorized changes or viewing.
